'''Geddy''' was a [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], who, along with [[Grintlok]], [[Kubla]] and an [[unidentified Feeorin]] kidnapped [[Mi]], the daughter of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Arturo]], to demand ransom for her release. After Grintlok hired [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to deliver the princess to their base on [[Raltac III]], the group was contacted by [[Raze (criminal)|Raze]], who in turn hired them to rescue the princess for a significant reward. The four intercepted Solo on [[Cataalda]] and were planning to kill him to get to the princess when Raze arrived at the place, along with Arturo himself. Mi identified the gang as her captives and Raze promised Arturo to deal with them personally.
